questions.q: What does a data dictionary document for this pipeline?
options: Every column in dw.FactWorkOrder and its dimensions, with what each one means
The exact click sequence to deploy the SSIS project
A history of every SQL Server Agent job run
The Power BI workspace's list of members
questions.explain: A data dictionary is the reference for what every warehouse column actually holds — the first thing a new teammate should be able to open.

questions.q: What should an ETL runbook for WorkOrderETL.dtsx cover?
options: What the package does, in what order, and what to check first if it fails
Only the visual layout of the SSIS control flow, with no operational detail
The DAX formulas used in the Power BI dashboard
The report server's IP address, and nothing else
questions.explain: A runbook is operational: it tells whoever's on call what the package actually does step by step, and where to look first when it fails.

options: Which AdventureWorks2012 column feeds which specific warehouse column
The visual formatting of the Power BI dashboard
The SQL Server Agent job's schedule
Which report server the .rdl was deployed to
questions.explain: Source-to-target mapping traces each warehouse column back to the exact source column it came from — essential for tracking down a wrong number.

questions.q: What does SSMS's Database Diagrams tool provide that a hand-drawn ER diagram doesn't?
options: A diagram of dw.FactWorkOrder's keys and relationships drawn straight from the live schema, so it can't drift out of date the way a hand-drawn diagram can
Automatic generation of an ETL runbook
A built-in SQL Server Agent scheduler
The ability to publish directly to Power BI
questions.explain: Because Database Diagrams reads the live schema, it stays accurate as the schema evolves, unlike a diagram someone drew once and never updated.

questions.q: What does sp_addextendedproperty attach a column description to, and why does that matter?
options: The schema itself, in the database — so the description is queryable and travels with the schema, unlike a wiki page
A Power BI report's visual, so it shows a tooltip
The SQL Server Agent job step, so it logs a comment
A local text file only the original developer can open
questions.explain: Extended properties are metadata stored inside the database itself and can be queried directly — documentation that can't silently go stale the way an external wiki page can.
